description: An object variable holds one record of a named schema (ADR-0031). A formula reads a field by its path, through object fields to a scalar leaf, which binds like a scalar variable; a whole object, and a path that stops on an object, are not yet supported in a formula.

reject.reason: a whole object is not a value in a formula yet
a path that stops on an object is a whole object
a scalar variable has no fields
the leaf has the field's type: text in arithmetic
a decimal leaf and a number leaf never mix implicitly
rows columns are not supported yet
